lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [storyteller] This is you. In real life, you're just a kid. [pause] But in Cube City... you're a legend.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Level ninety-nine. The best base in Tycoon Valley. Two thousand wins in the arena.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [proud] Two thousand and ONE.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [showing off] Welcome to my castle. [pause] Lava pool. Trophy room. [pause] And this... is my throne.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [deadpan] The throne was just a chair. [pause] A very expensive chair.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That's Noodle. Your best friend. You've never met in real life... [pause] but you've beaten four hundred bosses together.

lines.speaker: NOODLE
lines.text: [excited] Bro! Bro, bro, bro! New update! [pause] The Block King is coming!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And that's DarkBlade. Nobody knows who he really is. [pause] Nobody knows why he's always so angry.

lines.speaker: DARKBLADE
lines.text: [edgy, slow] You got lucky last time, YOU. [pause] Enjoy your little castle.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [smug] Enjoy your little losing streak.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But on Saturday morning... real life happened.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There's Dad. An accountant. He thinks every video game is called "the Nintendo."

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There's Mom. A very quiet librarian. [pause] She says "shh" more than any other word.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And there's Granny. She knits. She bakes. [pause] And she has never lost an argument in her life.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [cheerful] Family meeting! [pause] Your mother and I have noticed you spend eleven hours a day in... the Nintendo.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [annoyed] It's not a Nintendo, Dad. It's Cube City.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.text: [calm, firm] So we made a decision. [pause] Tonight is Family Game Night.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [relieved] Oh. Board games. Okay, that's fine—

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.text: [sweetly] No, dear. [pause] We're joining YOUR game.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [horrified] You're joining... my SERVER?!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [deadpan] It was the scariest sentence you had ever heard.
